Precise mascot anatomy repair. Image 1 is the edit target. Image 2 is the original immutable mascot identity reference.

The arm that touches the phone on the RIGHT is WRONG: its rounded blue root starts inside the white facial screen. REMOVE that entire erroneous screen-rooted arm and glove, restoring the white face screen to a clean uninterrupted white rectangle beneath the mouth. Preserve face, eyes, eyebrows, cheeks, mouth, body outline, tall face-screen aspect ratio, both legs/shoes, and the OTHER hand holding the left phone exactly.

Rebuild ONLY the touching-side arm as a SHORT BLUE ARM originating visibly from the OUTER RIGHT BLUE SIDE FRAME of the mascot, never from the white screen. Its shoulder attachment must be on the exterior blue body contour. Bend the arm outwards/downwards OUTSIDE the white screen to a white glove touching the separate phone on the stand. Keep the entire white face-screen interior free of arm roots or blue limb shapes. A visible side-frame-to-arm-to-glove connection is essential. If necessary move the separate stand phone slightly right to leave a small visible gap for the properly side-attached arm. Exactly TWO arms and TWO hands total, not three. No extra glove remnants. Very short original cute limb proportions.

All Korean text, icons, background, furniture, other phone, mascot facial identity, body color #7CAEFD and overall composition remain unchanged. No redesign, no thumbs-up, no limb emerging from screen or belly.

prompts.title: 자급제폰 사용할 때 주의사항
prompts.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Generate ONE square 1:1 Korean 2D Naver blog illustration per call, not a multi-page collage. Image 1 is the mandatory immutable JoyMobile mascot IDENTITY reference, not pose/layout reference. Exactly ONE mascot. Preserve original smartphone body silhouette/proportions, particularly the tall white face-screen aspect ratio, original eyes/brows/cheeks/mouth, #7CAEFD body, outlines and line weight. Very short cute arms and legs, white gloves and blue shoes, no added clothing, hair, hat, glasses, accessories, human/SD redesign, 3D or photorealism. Exactly 2 arms with 2 attached white-gloved hands and 2 short legs with 2 blue shoes, all distinguishable and visibly connected. No extra/missing/fused/floating limbs. Mascot on floor beside furniture (or naturally seated when requested), NEVER standing on a card/table/box/device. All other phones/SIMs/icons are ordinary FACELESS and LIMBLESS objects. Natural active poses, no thumbs-up, no rigid front-facing attention pose, no advertising index-finger pointing.
Fixed palette ONLY #0138A6 #0E59DC #7CAEFD #6BA2FD #D7EAFE #FDC953 #F85045 #FED3CB #FEFEFE #030202. Use blue/white furniture, blue foliage, blue phone buttons; no green or brown additions. Bright clean polished 2D, legible exact Korean, generous whitespace/mobile crop safe margins. No official logos, real UI copies, personal/ID/authentication data, IMEI/serial numbers, scannable QR, watermark, invented prices/plans/conditions or universal/guaranteed claims. Omit subheading numbers in titles; retain meaningful actual step numbers only.

Title "자급제폰 사용할 때 주의사항". Concept: new-phone pre-activation inspection station.
Five clearly labeled checks, all exact:
"국내 통신망 지원" phone plus antenna
"유심 규격" SIM plus slot
"eSIM 지원 여부" abstract digital SIM inside ordinary phone
"5G 지원 여부" 5G text plus signal
"중고폰 정상 해지 여부" ordinary used phone plus check.
Main key phrases "개통 전에 CHECK", "호환 여부를 먼저 확인", "유심 · eSIM · 5G".
One mascot on LEFT side of a low blue/white inspection table, holding a small ordinary phone with BOTH white-gloved hands and gently rotating it to inspect the front/back and SIM slot. Natural slight forward lean, body angled to read the support-information callout, both short legs and blue shoes FULLY visible beside table, no obstruction by table. Only two gloves, no detached icon hands. No actual IMEI/serial numbers, personal information, exact real UI, or invented technical standards. Device inspection action, no pointing or thumbs-up, preserve the tall original mascot white-screen face ratio.

Closing summary infographic title "자급제폰 개통방법 총정리".
One central ordinary new unlocked smartphone branches to THREE choices:
"기존 유심" / "그대로 옮겨 사용"
"알뜰폰" / "매월 납부 방식이 일반적" / "장기간 · 다양한 요금제"
"선불폰" / "먼저 충전 후 사용" / "목적에 따라 유연하게".
Under the three routes a shared check strip with exact labels:
"유심 규격", "기기 호환", "eSIM", "5G", "중고폰 상태".
Main decision text:
"자급제폰" → "원하는 통신 방식 선택" → "사용 목적에 맞게 결정".
Make the overall flow clear to a new reader: "자급제폰 구매" → "기존 유심 / 알뜰폰 / 선불폰 선택" → "호환 여부 확인" → "사용".
One mascot near the bottom right, turned slightly sideways, one white glove holds an ordinary phone while the other glove gently fits a generic SIM into its side tray, with a small blue connection check nearby. Both white hands attached, both short legs and blue shoes fully visible without table or cards obscuring them. Natural finishing action, no front-facing thumbs-up or price pointing.
Bottom inset brand badge exactly two lines:
"조이모바일.com"
"개통센터 대표번호 / 010-4486-2532".
Keep main title, character face and brand inside mobile-safe margins, sufficient typography size, tidy blue/white with yellow highlights. No invented prices, identifiers or guarantees.
